$about: QQ Digits: the countdown's seven-segment digits (Tim, round 6: the program, so the segments can be animated). One drawing in units of 1000 to the em, the baseline at 0: every digit lights some of the same seven segments (a top, b top right, c bottom right, d bottom, e bottom left, f top left, g middle), so the unlit ones (the trace) line up under every digit. «00:00:00» is exactly 3 em wide (fit3em). Drawn in the artifact «QQ Digits» (https://claude.ai/artifact/4LtGUy5Q1z2tsYrAb5oGK7); these are Tim's settings from it. build/digits.mjs turns them into the hero's SVG; scripts/digits.js lights the segments. traceDark / traceLight: the opacity of the unlit segments on black and on paper; fade: the ms a segment takes to turn off (it turns on in 0.6 of that).
